projects.summary: An audit dashboard concept that turns technical findings into clear priorities.
projects.description:
A findings list groups issues by severity and pairs each item with context and a suggested next action. This is an interface concept, not an audit result.

Make technical security findings understandable to a small operations team. The proposed scope includes severity filters, finding details, remediation notes and report layouts.

This sample case study demonstrates how a completed project can be presented. The figures and client are illustrative, and the video is placeholder footage.
